name: EchoFreeze
description: Octatrack-style echo freeze. A tempo-synced delay keeps writing AUDIO IN until you lock it. Touch toggles Lock: Send drops out and the captured buffer loops forever. X = buffer length in beats, Y = playback rate / pitch.

params.name: PITCH
params.detail: Playback rate when locked (down an octave to up a fifth)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Wet level of the frozen buffer

params.name: MODE
params.detail: HOLD = lock while touching, TOGL = tap to lock/unlock
